metadata.case_name: LEE KIM FUNG v. LOK LUN KEUNG AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: urethral laceration and subsequent bulbomembranous urethral stricture
source: pelvic fracture causing urethral laceration and subsequent stricture requiring anastomotic surgery and multiple dilations thereafter

injuries.icd_description: Fracture of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.description: fracture right acetabulum (right hip) with subsequent femoral head resorption and loosening of screw
source: repeated x-ray revealed loosening of a screw and suspected screw protusion leading to femoral head resorption
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: pain when the left arm was extended and there is no strength
left arm cannot be raised above shoulder level
frequent pain at right pelvis and right knee particularly on walking
cannot raise the right hip joint to more that 90 degrees without risk of dislocation
wastage of muscle at the inner side of the right thigh which cannot regenerate
impaired sensation over the lateral aspect of right thigh
lack of strength in urination; frequent passing of urine with leakage and wetting of underpants; slow urinary stream
loss of sleep due to pain at leg
weak body, frequent dizziness and fatigue
loss of confidence and feeling sad, depressed and worried about future living and health
needs a walking stick for walking
difficulty climbing up or down stairs
cannot tie his shoelace; cannot wear his socks without an instrument; cannot cut his toenail
requires regular physiotherapy (attended physiotherapy treatments 254 times up to 19 November 2002)

treatments_received: close reduction and external fixation of the left humerus (18 May 1999)
open reduction and internal fixation of fractured right acetabulum (25 May 1999)
tube in lung for transferring blood (first operation after admission)
removal of external fixator of the left humerus and application of humeral brace
balloon dilatation of urethral stricture (12 November 1999)
removal of right hip implants (13 January 2000)
total hip replacement (operation performed during hospitalization 31 October 2001 to 16 November 2001)
treatments_future: two revision hip replacement surgeries (judge awarded two revision surgeries at $120,000 each)

losses.description: Urological injury including urethral stricture, ongoing urinary dysfunction and sexual dysfunction/impotence requiring Viagra
Needs walking stick, difficulty climbing stairs, frequent right hip and knee pain on walking

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Cannot tie shoelace, cannot wear socks without an instrument, cannot cut toenails

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Used to enjoy jogging and ball games frequently but after the accident cannot enjoy these sports anymore
Relationship with his girl friend is greatly affected by sexual dysfunction and loss of desire

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Loss of confidence and increased worry about future living and health
